definitions.explanation: A country that extracts crude oil and exports it as a significant part of its economy. Often used in discussions of international economics, energy policy, and geopolitics.

examples.japanese: {中東|ちゅうとう}の{産油国|さんゆこく}。
examples.english: Oil-producing countries in the Middle East.

examples.japanese: {産油国|さんゆこく}は{石油|せきゆ}の{価格|かかく}を{巡|めぐ}って{対立|たいりつ}している。
examples.english: Oil-producing countries are at odds over petroleum prices.

examples.japanese: サウジアラビアは{世界|せかい}{有数|ゆうすう}の{産油国|さんゆこく}である。
examples.english: Saudi Arabia is one of the world's leading oil-producing countries.

examples.japanese: {主要|しゅよう}{産油国|さんゆこく}が{減産|げんさん}に{合意|ごうい}したことで、{原油|げんゆ}{価格|かかく}が{上昇|じょうしょう}した。
examples.english: After major oil-producing countries agreed to cut production, crude oil prices rose.

notes:
A frequently used term in news about energy markets and international politics. Composed of {産油|さんゆ} (oil production) + {国|こく} (country).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {産油国|さんゆこく}{機構|きこう}: organization of oil-producing countries (i.e., OPEC)
- {主要|しゅよう}{産油国|さんゆこく}: major oil-producing countries
- {世界|せかい}{有数|ゆうすう}の{産油国|さんゆこく}: one of the world's leading oil-producing countries
- {産油国|さんゆこく}の{経済|けいざい}: the economies of oil-producing countries
- {非|ひ}{産油国|さんゆこく}: non-oil-producing countries

RELATED TERMS:
- OPEC / {石油|せきゆ}{輸出国機構|ゆしゅつこくきこう}: Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries
- {原油|げんゆ}: crude oil
- {石油|せきゆ}: petroleum; oil
- {消費国|しょうひこく}: consumer country — the opposite side of the oil trade
- {埋蔵量|まいぞうりょう}: (underground) reserves

USAGE:
Japan is not a {産油国|さんゆこく} and imports almost all its oil, so the word often appears in Japanese news from the perspective of a country affected by producers' decisions.
